# The static assets route serves the files under the static assets
# directory as they are: they are not templates of the package, even when
# the package embeds them. muxt fmt reads them only as stylesheets. The
# <style> element in assets/index.html does not make .x block, so the span
# is left inline, and a file there that does not parse as a template does
# not break the package.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt fmt page.gohtml
cmp stdout page.gohtml
! stderr .

cp mustache.txt assets/list.html
muxt fmt page.gohtml
cmp stdout page.gohtml
! stderr .

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml assets
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- assets/site.css --
p{color:red}
-- assets/index.html --
<style>.x{display:block}</style>
-- mustache.txt --
<ul>{{#each items}}<li>{{this}}</li>{{/each}}</ul>
-- layout.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/site.css">{{end}}
-- page.gohtml --
<p>a<span class="x">b</span> c</p>
